data.one_liner: Provides a type-safe Angle class for degrees, radians, gradians and turns with conversion and trig helpers.
data.what_it_does: The package defines an Angle type that can be created from various units and accessed in any unit. It includes common trigonometric functions, arithmetic operators and utility methods like normalization and approximation.
use_when: You need clear, unit‑safe angle handling in Dart code
You want built‑in trig functions without manual conversions
avoid_when: You need advanced graphics or physics engines
strengths: Rich API with constructors, accessors, trig and arithmetic
weaknesses: Focused only on angles, no broader geometry support
